verdict.rationale: The site tells users to "Install the ones you want" and "Pick the skills and agents you use." A real end-to-end probe ran `npx skills add mattpocock/skills --skill tdd` and installed only the single `tdd` skill into the project. The Claude Code, Codex and Copilot plugin routes install the whole set as a bundle, but the skills.sh path clearly supports selective installs. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the per-skill selection flag, and selective install on the plugin-marketplace routes.
